page.layout: Running head at top, centred, with page number at top left. One text block of Latin and Arabic with marginal notes in the left margin beside the first paragraph. Below a rule, a centred Arabic and Latin heading, then a paragraph and a numbered list in the same column. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: Abul Feda, &c. Primus (inquit) Regum Syriæ fuit * Male in exempl. quo usus sum legitur, الحارث AlHareth, f. Amri, f. Ameri, f. Haretha, f. Amrilkais, f. Mazeni, f. AlAzdi, &c. qui & ابن ابي شمر Ebn Abi Shamer appellatus. Successerunt ipsi in imperio {*} سبع وثلاثون 37. Reges, spatium autem quo regnarunt erat annorum 616, usque ad ultimum ipsorum جبلة Iabalah, qui imperante Omaro Christianismum amplexus est. Quod si ita se habeat, ac B. Paulus anno Christi 34. (ut Sethus Calvis.) per Damasci munimenta in sporta demissus fit, Omar autem anno 634. imperare coeperit. erit Aretas iste cuius mentio 2 Cor. 11. 32. è prioribus familiæ Gassaniæ regibus, forsan primus iste Harethus.
main_text.head: ملوك جرهم Reges Iorhamida.
main_text.p: Regnante Yaarebo in Yaman, regnavit in Hejaz.
main_text.l: 2 عبد ياليك Abd Talik, Iorhami filius.
4 عبد المدان Abdol Madan, Iorshami filius.
5 نقيلة Nogailah (vel forf. نقيلة Nakilah, vel نفيلة Nophailah. AbdolMadani filius

page.notes: Marginal note in the left margin reads "* Male in exempl. quo usus sum legitur," followed by Arabic "سبعون وثلاثون", which is the corrected reading of the Arabic numeral in the text (marked here as a footnote with {*}). The Arabic in the margin and in the text is small and partly uncertain; the Arabic personal names are transcribed as they appear but may contain small errors. The Latin in list line 5 is cut by the scan edge and is set in the original with an unclosed parenthesis. Line 12 ends with an unclosed parenthesis, as printed.
